comment: D-PLY-35 (2026-10-28): the player slot's watchdog, derived from the helper's own bounds. Run by BOTH
tests/Model.test.js and tests/test_player_bounds.py. A number implemented in two languages gets one
fixture (engineering rule, dev branch).
`helper` is every bound a `player start|restart|probe` can wait out, in milliseconds, and `names` is
the helper's own name for each with its unit (bin/helper/01-core.py, 07-player.py): the python side
reads each off the helper by that name, so a bound that moves there without moving here is red. The
model mirrors the same numbers (Model.PLAYER_BOUNDS, and Model.STOP_QUIT_GRACE_MS and
STOP_KILL_GRACE_MS, which the stop ladder already shares); node compares them with `helper`.
`watchdogMs` is Model.playerWatchdogMs per verb, the shell's playerWatchdog interval while that verb
runs, and "" is the bound on the birth edge when no verb runs (unchanged from 12 s). The arithmetic,
with i = ipcMs, the longest path through the helper's code with every wait it survives at its full
bound plus the one wait that ends it (model/player.mjs says why each term is there):
ladder("")     = max(quitGraceMs, 2i) + killGraceMs + 2 settleMs        = 4000 + 2000 + 1000 = 7000
ladder("term") = killGraceMs + 2 settleMs                               = 3000
spawn          = settleConnectMs + spawnPidMs + 2 spawnMs + 2i          = 200 + 2000 + 10000 + 4000 = 16200
tail           = max(ladder("term") + settleConnectMs, i + firstLoadMs) = max(3200, 5000) = 5000
start   = lockMs + lockPollMs + 2i + ladder("") + spawn + tail + marginMs = 6050 + 4000 + 7000 + 16200 + 5000 + 5000 = 43250
restart = lockMs + lockPollMs + ladder("term") + settleConnectMs + spawn + tail + marginMs
probe   = max(3i, settleLockMs + lockPollMs + settleConnectMs) + marginMs = max(6000, 750) + 5000 = 11000
`boardMs` is the sum the board row named (lock + spawn + first load), which the old 12 s was under;
`previousMs` is that 12 s.
